notes.title: Demo Hits This October!
notes.content: [h3]Welcome to the Drone Arsenal demo![/h3][p]Set for release in October 2025, the demo offers a vertical slice of the game, showcasing core mechanics, gameplay, and the potential of the full version. Wishlist the demo on Steam to get access right at launch![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640593/30a685d6fe0613a824f4169e1c9d14f5569c57bc.png"][/img][/p][h3]What’s Included in the Demo[/h3][list][*][p]Vertical Slice of Gameplay: Experience the core of the game—from drone control to tactical battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Campaign: 3 levels with increasing difficulty, showcasing story progression and mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Arsenal: 3 drone types with unique abilities and 10 weapon varieties, including prototypes from the full version.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Why You Should Try It[/h3][p]- The demo is a complete slice of the game, giving you a clear sense of what Drone Arsenal is about.[/p][p]- Your demo progress won’t carry over to the main game, so feel free to experiment freely![/p][p]- Your feedback on Steam will help us refine the game before launch.[/p][p][/p][h3]How to Get Access[/h3][p]1. Visit the [b]Drone Arsenal[/b] demo page on Steam.[/p][p]2. Click “Add to Wishlist” to secure access to the demo in October 2025.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640593/5fc29f6c51384fd08d8635b1feb2f21a703b5b59.png"][/img][/p]
